mapper.sql: org_id, org_name, org_code, up_id, sort, create_time, creator_id, org_level, org_path, dept_name
mapper.insert: insert into sys_org( org_id, org_name, org_code, up_id, sort, create_time, creator_id, org_level, org_path, dept_name )values( #{orgId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{orgName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{orgCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{upId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{sort, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{createTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{creatorId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{orgLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{orgPath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deptName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.delete: delete from sys_org where org_id = #{orgId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.update:
update sys_org a a.org_id = #{orgId}, a.org_name = #{orgName}, a.org_code = #{orgCode}, a.up_id = #{upId}, a.sort = #{sort, jdbcType=INTEGER}, a.create_time = #{createTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, a.creator_id = #{creatorId}, a.org_level = #{orgLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER}, a.org_path = #{orgPath}, a.dept_name = #{deptName},
where a.org_id = #{orgId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.select: select a.org_id, a.org_name, a.org_code, a.up_id, a.sort, a.create_time, a.creator_id, a.org_level, a.org_path, a.dept_name from sys_org a where 1 = 1 and a.org_id = #{orgId, jdbcType=BIGINT} limit 1

SELECT a.org_id AS Id, a.org_name AS label, a.up_id AS upId, b.org_name AS upName, a.org_code AS orgCode FROM sys_org a LEFT JOIN sys_org b ON a.up_id = b.org_id WHERE 1=1 AND a.org_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{orgName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')

SELECT DATA.org_id FROM ( SELECT @ids AS _ids, ( SELECT @ids := GROUP_CONCAT( org_id ) FROM sys_org WHERE FIND_IN_SET( up_id, @ids ) ) AS cids, @l := @l + 1 AS LEVEL FROM sys_org, ( SELECT @ids := #{orgId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, @l := 0 ) b WHERE @ids IS NOT NULL ) ID, sys_org DATA WHERE FIND_IN_SET( DATA.org_id, ID._ids ) ORDER BY LEVEL,org_id
select user_id from sys_user where org_id = #{orgId,jdbcType=BIGINT};
select * from sys_user where org_id != #{orgId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and org_code = #{orgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR};
